summary: The Upstage x AWS AI Initiative offers approved K-12/university institutions, university hospitals and nonprofits/NGOs free access to Solar Pro 4 and Document Parse for up to one year, subject to a fixed usage cutoff of March 31, 2027 at 23:00 KST. The official event/application page says usage runs from application approval until March 31, 2027; its Event Info supplies the 11:00 PM KST time. Applicants must pass internal review and receive instructions by email. Unlike the pricing page's broader hospitals shorthand, the event's eligibility specifically names university hospitals. The usage/program cutoff is not a separately stated application deadline, and approval does not guarantee a full year beyond it.
claim_steps: Read and apply through https://www.upstage.ai/events/ai-initiative-2026-en (linked from Upstage pricing). The current initiative covers Solar Pro 4 and Document Parse.

Check eligibility against the event's list: K-12 education/universities, university hospitals and NPOs/NGOs. Do not assume that the pricing page's broader hospitals wording makes every hospital eligible.
Submit the application and await internal review and approval. Approved applicants receive detailed instructions by email; processing may take time and acceptance is not automatic.

Use approved access for up to one year, but only until March 31, 2027 at 23:00 KST. This is the published usage/program cutoff, not a separately stated signup deadline; later approval does not extend it.
